SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, D.NAME AS FILENAME, D.ID AS FILEID, P.MONITORTMPLGROUP, E.TEMPLATENAME FROM T_EMC_INDEX_CATEGORY A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_FILE D ON D.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_INDEX_CATEGORY$', A.ID) LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL_GROUP P ON A.MONITORTMPLGROUPID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROPERTY_TMPL E ON E.ID = A.PROPERTYTMPLID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, P.MONITORTMPLGROUP, E.TEMPLATENAME FROM T_EMC_INDEX_CATEGORY T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL_GROUP P ON T.MONITORTMPLGROUPID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROPERTY_TMPL E ON E.ID = T.PROPERTYTMPLID WHERE T.ID = #{id}
